body:
<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NAV-018:20261101 -->
Implemented and verified all four original NAV-018 acceptance criteria in their source/provenance/static-distribution scope.

- Restored the known Apache copyright/license headers in the common CupertinoSlider and three iOS Kyant utilities, preserving every previous Kotlin byte and Calf modification notice. Existing NAV headers/full license texts remain intact.
- Traced ten adaptations through retained Calf Git commits, original authors/timestamps, blob hashes and path events. Exact third-party copy revisions remain explicitly unknown; comparison pins are not substituted for them.
- Reproduced and fixed a real publication omission: KGP 2.4.20 sources use `org.gradle.jvm.tasks.Jar`, while the old deprecated subclass hook missed all seven source JARs. Corrected the owning hook in `convention-plugins/src/main/kotlin/PublicationNotices.kt`.
- Actual corrected local UI producer succeeds (231.05s); the static seven-target source/primary/companion gate passes **773/773**. All seven source JARs retain 20 complete notices, all 705 original source/manifest payloads remain exact, and all 14 primary/companion archives retain reviewed bytes. The first 140-failure gate is preserved. 20 distinct scoped synthetic outcomes were accepted across separate commands, not a fresh 20-test native run.

Fix: e525f99c. Exact frozen 1023-library/1100-combined/25-legal inputs also match committed/pushed 99387d3a. Independent [four-literal-criterion review](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/99387d3a/docs/development/evidence/derived-apache-notices-20261101/independent-review001/REVIEW.md) and [actual evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/99387d3a/docs/development/evidence/derived-apache-notices-20261101/README.md).

Navigation has no current publication producer; future NAV distributions remain subject to the explicit owning notice gate. Linux-produced iOS compiler objects are static distribution evidence, not Apple linking/runtime. No ABI, packaged-consumer, full legal/security/readiness or release clearance is claimed. No registry package, release, deployment or Pages action was performed.
